hints.title: Banned Words Membership
hints.text: Store all bannedWords into a lookup set for O(1) retrieval speed.

hints.title: Early Termination Condition
hints.text: Iterate through message and count matches with the set. Return true as soon as count reaches 2.

hints.title: Default Fallback
hints.text: If fewer than 2 words match after scanning the entire message, return false.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash set creation takes O(b). Message scanning takes O(m) with early exit.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search through bannedWords for every word in message takes O(m * b) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(b) memory to store the banned words set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies hash set with early exit on meeting threshold 2.
